qa_pairs.question: How do I charge the NovaBook 14, and what adapter does it need?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The NovaBook 14 charges through either of its two USB-C ports with a 65 W USB-C Power Delivery adapter. A lower-wattage adapter may charge slowly but may not maintain charge during heavy use.

contexts.text: It charges through either USB-C port with a 65 W USB-C Power Delivery adapter. A lower-wattage adapter may charge slowly but may not maintain charge during heavy use.

qa_pairs.question: How much does OrbitPlus membership cost per year and what benefits does it include?

It does not discount devices, repair charges, gift cards, taxes, express shipping, or clearance products.

contexts.text: OrbitPlus is an annual membership costing USD 49. qa_pairs.question: How long do standard and express domestic shipping normally take?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Standard domestic shipping normally arrives in three to five business days after dispatch and express shipping in one to two business days after dispatch. These are service estimates, not guarantees. Orders to designated remote areas require two additional business days, and weekends and public carrier holidays are not business days.

contexts.text: Standard domestic shipping normally arrives in three to five business days after dispatch. Express shipping normally arrives in one to two business days after dispatch. These are service estimates, not guarantees. Orders to designated remote areas require two additional business days. Weekends and public carrier holidays are not business days.

qa_pairs.question: Will OrbitTech support ever ask me for my password or one-time code, and can they show my full card number?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No. OrbitTech staff will never request a password or one-time authentication code. Payment-card details displayed in the account are masked and cannot be revealed by support.

qa_pairs.question: I opened my laptop and want to return it. I paid partly with a gift card, so what fee applies and how will the refund reach me?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days and is subject to a 10% restocking fee. After inspection, refunds are issued to the original payment methods within five to seven business days, but OrbitTech cannot refund cash for the gift-card-funded portion; that amount returns to a replacement gift card. Original standard-shipping fees are not refunded for preference returns.

contexts.text: An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days and is subject to a 10% restocking fee.

After inspection, refunds are issued to the original payment methods within five to seven business days. Gift-card portions return to a replacement gift card. Original standard-shipping fees are not refunded for preference returns.
OrbitTech cannot refund cash for a gift-card-funded portion; that amount returns to a replacement gift card.

qa_pairs.question: My order already moved to Packing. Can I still cancel it, and what happens if a carrier interception fails?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: An order can be cancelled from the account page only while its status is `Confirmed`; once the status becomes `Packing`, cancellation is no longer guaranteed. Support may request a carrier interception, but interception fees are non-refundable and success is not guaranteed. If interception fails, you must use the return process after delivery, where an unopened standard device may be returned within 30 calendar days after confirmed delivery for orders placed on or after September 1, 2026.

contexts.text: An order can be cancelled from the account page while its status is `Confirmed`. Once the status becomes `Packing`, cancellation is no longer guaranteed. Support may request a carrier interception, but interception fees are non-refundable and success is not guaranteed. If interception fails, the customer must use the return process after delivery.
For orders placed on or after September 1, 2026, an unopened standard device may be returned within 30 calendar days after confirmed delivery.

qa_pairs.question: Can I apply two percentage-off codes to one order and then pay with OrbitPay instalments using a gift card for the deposit?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No to both. Only one percentage-off promotional code may be applied to an order; a percentage code may be combined with a gift card, but not with another percentage code or a clearance markdown. OrbitPay instalments are available for eligible device purchases of at least USD 300 after discounts and require 25% at checkout plus three equal monthly payments, and gift cards cannot fund the initial 25%.

contexts.text: Only one percentage-off promotional code may be applied to an order. A percentage code may be combined with a gift card, but not with another percentage code or a clearance markdown.

OrbitPay instalments are available for eligible device purchases of at least USD 300 after discounts. The plan requires 25% at checkout and three equal monthly payments. Gift cards cannot fund the initial 25%.

qa_pairs.question: My package has had no tracking movement for days. When is it officially delayed, and when can I get a refund or replacement?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: A package is considered delayed when it has no tracking update for three business days beyond the latest estimated delivery date, and at that point support may open a carrier trace. A refund or replacement is not issued while an active trace is within its five-business-day investigation period. A failed carrier trace is one of the situations that may move the case to a specialist.

contexts.text: A package is considered delayed when it has no tracking update for three business days beyond the latest estimated delivery date. At that point, support may open a carrier trace. A refund or replacement is not issued while an active trace is within its five-business-day investigation period.
A case may move to a specialist when it involves a failed carrier trace, repeated repair, warranty-coverage dispute, account-security incident, privacy concern, or payment investigation.

qa_pairs.question: How long does a repair take, and what do I pay if the damage is not covered and I decline the quote?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Initial diagnosis normally takes up to three business days after the service centre receives the product, and a covered repair normally takes up to ten additional business days when parts are available; these periods exclude shipping time and time waiting for customer approval. Damage such as accidental impact or liquid exposure is excluded from the warranty, so OrbitTech sends a written quote that remains valid for seven calendar days. If you decline, a diagnostic fee of USD 35 applies unless remote support confirmed before shipment that no diagnostic fee would be charged.

contexts.text: Initial diagnosis normally takes up to three business days after the service centre receives the product. A covered repair normally takes up to ten additional business days when parts are available. These periods exclude shipping time and time waiting for customer approval.

For an out-of-warranty or excluded issue, OrbitTech sends a written quote. The quote remains valid for seven calendar days. Work begins only after approval and required payment. If the customer declines, a diagnostic fee of USD 35 applies unless remote support confirmed before shipment that no diagnostic fee would be charged.

The warranty excludes loss, theft, cosmetic wear, depleted consumables, accidental impact, liquid exposure, electrical damage from an unsupported charger, unauthorized modification, and repair by a non-authorized provider.

qa_pairs.question: I opened the spare ear tips that came with my AeroBuds Pro. Can I still return them?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No, unless they are defective. Opened ear-tip packages are treated as hygiene accessories, and opened ear tips, in-ear audio products, screen protectors, and other hygiene or single-use accessories are non-returnable unless defective.

contexts.text: Opened ear-tip packages are treated as hygiene accessories under `05_returns_and_exchanges.md`.
Opened ear tips, in-ear audio products, screen protectors, and other hygiene or single-use accessories are non-returnable unless defective.

qa_pairs.question: Someone placed an order from my account without my permission. What should I do first?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: Reset the password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security. If the unauthorized order is still `Confirmed`, also attempt cancellation from the account page. If it is already packing or dispatched, Account Security coordinates with the Payments and Delivery teams, and cancellation or interception is not guaranteed.

contexts.text: A customer who suspects account compromise should reset the password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security. If an unauthorized order is still `Confirmed`, the customer should also attempt cancellation under `02_orders_and_payments.md`. If it is already packing or dispatched, Account Security coordinates with the Payments and Delivery teams; cancellation or interception is not guaranteed.
An order can be cancelled from the account page while its status is `Confirmed`.

qa_pairs.question: I am an active OrbitPlus member and placed an order on August 20, 2026. How many calendar days do I have to return the unopened device?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: 21 calendar days. For return-policy eligibility the triggering event is the order-placement date, so an order placed on August 20, 2026 falls under Return Policy version 1.0, which allowed 21 calendar days for unopened devices, seven calendar days for opened devices, and a 15% opened-device restocking fee. Orders placed before September 1 keep the 21-day version 1.0 window regardless of membership, so the 45-day OrbitPlus extension does not apply. The days are counted from confirmed delivery.

contexts.text: For return-policy eligibility, the triggering event is the order-placement date, while the number of return days is counted from confirmed delivery.

Return Policy version 1.0 applies to orders placed before September 1, 2026. It allowed 21 calendar days for unopened devices, seven calendar days for opened devices, and charged a 15% opened-device restocking fee.
Orders placed before September 1 keep the 21-day version 1.0 window regardless of membership.
OrbitPlus extends the unopened-device return window from 30 to 45 calendar days for eligible purchases made while membership is active.

qa_pairs.question: My express order arrived two days after the committed date because I entered the wrong street address. Will OrbitTech refund the express shipping fee?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No. Express-shipping fees are refunded when an express package arrives after the carrier's committed service date, unless the delay resulted from an incorrect address, unavailable recipient, customs hold, severe weather, or another listed carrier exception, so an incorrect address removes the refund. The shipping address may be edited only while an order is `Confirmed`, and changing the destination country is never allowed; that requires cancelling and placing a new order.

contexts.text: Express-shipping fees are refunded when an express package arrives after the carrier's committed service date, unless the delay resulted from an incorrect address, unavailable recipient, customs hold, severe weather, or another listed carrier exception.
The shipping address may be edited only while an order is `Confirmed`. For security, changing the destination country is never allowed; the customer must cancel and place a new order.

qa_pairs.question: If OrbitTech replaces my phone under warranty, does a new 24-month coverage period start from the replacement date?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No. A replacement device does not restart a new 24-month warranty, and the coverage period begins on delivery or store collection of the original order. OrbitTech chooses the remedy after diagnosis among repair, replacement with an equivalent new or refurbished unit, or refund when the first two remedies are not reasonable. Replacement parts are covered for the longer of 90 calendar days or the remainder of the original warranty.

contexts.text: Warranty service may result in repair, replacement with an equivalent new or refurbished unit, or refund when the first two remedies are not reasonable. OrbitTech chooses the remedy after diagnosis. Replacement parts are covered for the longer of 90 calendar days or the remainder of the original warranty. A replacement device does not restart a new 24-month warranty.
For warranty, the coverage period begins on delivery or store collection.

qa_pairs.question: I dropped my NovaBook 14 and cracked the screen, then bought OrbitPlus the next day. Is the repair covered by the warranty now?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: No. The warranty excludes accidental impact, and accidental damage is not converted into a warranty claim by purchasing OrbitPlus after the incident. The damage may still be repairable for a fee: for an out-of-warranty or excluded issue OrbitTech sends a written quote, which remains valid for seven calendar days, and work begins only after approval and required payment.

contexts.text: The warranty excludes loss, theft, cosmetic wear, depleted consumables, accidental impact, liquid exposure, electrical damage from an unsupported charger, unauthorized modification, and repair by a non-authorized provider.
Accidental damage may still be repairable for a fee, but it is not converted into a warranty claim by purchasing OrbitPlus after the incident.
For an out-of-warranty or excluded issue, OrbitTech sends a written quote. The quote remains valid for seven calendar days. Work begins only after approval and required payment.

qa_pairs.expected_answer: A promotional bundle must be returned as a bundle. If you keep a free gift or one bundled item, its stated promotional value is deducted from the refund, and this rule also applies when the main device is otherwise within the return window.

qa_pairs.question: Since OrbitTech gives everyone a 60-day return window on opened devices, can I return my opened NovaBook 14 on day 50?
qa_pairs.expected_answer: The premise is incorrect; no 60-day opened-device return window exists in the policy. An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days and is subject to a 10% restocking fee, so day 50 falls outside the window. The assistant may describe a policy but cannot promise an exception, and it must not invent a discount or legal right.

contexts.text: The assistant may describe a policy but cannot view a live order, issue a refund, approve a warranty claim, unlock an account, change a delivery address, or promise an exception. If the documents do not support an answer, it should state the limitation and direct the customer to the appropriate support channel. It must not invent a product specification, delivery status, discount, or legal right.
An opened standard device may be returned within 14 calendar days and is subject to a 10% restocking fee.
